title: Bauplan
description: Enable notifications for this device. New task assignments notify only the assignee; self-assignments are excluded.
rules: Open tasks, quotes and unpaid invoices: 3 days before and on the deadline at 09:00 (Europe/Berlin). Timed appointments: 1 hour before. Quote, payment and appointment reminders go to all users with push enabled.
ios: On iPhone: open the Home Screen app on iOS 16.4 or later. Permission is per device. Enable again after signing out or session expiry.
privacy: Encrypted delivery uses the browser's push service (e.g. Apple). Messages contain no names, amounts or document contents.
unsupported: Push is unavailable here. Use HTTPS and a supported browser or the installed Home Screen app.
notConfigured: Push requires an admin account with a valid email address. The contact address is selected automatically.
enabled: Push is enabled on this device.
disabled: Push is disabled on this device.
testSent: Test submitted to the push service.
permission: Please allow notifications in your device/browser settings.
worker: The service worker is not active yet. Reopen the installed app after updating.
push.device_missing: Please enable push again on this device.
assignment: A task was assigned to you. Open Bauplan for details.
task: One of your open tasks is due soon.
offer: An open quote is approaching its expiry date.
payment: An unpaid invoice / expense is due.
event: An appointment starts in less than an hour.
test: Push notifications are working on this device.
